easy:mcq:1.stem: A bag contains 8 red tokens and 2 blue tokens. One token is chosen at random. What is the probability it is red?

distractorNotes.A: That is the chance of one particular token, not of any red one.
distractorNotes.B: That is the probability of blue.
distractorNotes.C: The value was halved somewhere along the way.

solution: There are 8 favorable outcomes and 10 equally likely outcomes in total.
So $P(\text{red}) = \frac{8}{10} = \frac{4}{5}$.
